name: pi-vlm-proxy
description: Generic vision proxy extension for pi: lets non-multimodal models (e.g. DeepSeek) delegate image analysis to ANY OpenAI-compatible multimodal model. Zero vendor hardcoding - a model is just baseUrl + apiKey + model id. Auto-hides itself when the main mode
